hotel_name: Alaya Stays By Elivaas Emperor Palms - Hotel In Delhi

positive_snippets: Thank you for the excellent hospitality. The staff was polite, the rooms were well-maintained, and the overall service was very satisfying. Looking forward to visiting again.

I had a really good stay at ASEP hotel. The staff were friendly, check-in was quick, and my room was clean and comfortable. The location was convenient and the breakfast had decent variety. Only downside was the Wi-Fi being a bit slow, but overall it was a smooth and pleasant experience. I’d happily stay again.
